note: The GDPR Repo Scanner's engine runs inside Plainflow (src/scanner) and its report is rebuilt as the Report tab, so nothing links out. 'origin' records where the engine came from.

scanner.name: GDPR Repo Scanner
scanner.blurb: Paste a public GitHub link and Plainflow reads the code here in your browser: where personal data goes, which outside services and AI it calls, and whether a DPIA looks likely.
scanner.then: Then open it as a picture to get the same answer as any other idea.
